historical_review_base.note: Older-base precision comparison is confounded by the cloud-model-choice rule added on main; current-main paired results isolate this PR.

limitations: Existing frozen split has historical reuse; intervals are descriptive, not new untouched holdout evidence.

Human test recall decreases 0.625 percentage points; its interval is [-2.143, 0] points. The point estimate meets the existing <=1 point constraint; this does not establish noninferiority at that margin with 95% confidence.
All-traffic recall decreases due to suppressing compiled cues on complete machine envelopes. Do not describe all-traffic recall as preserved.
No live-provider or production deployment measurement. The regression property separately exercises spent deadlines and synthetic provider failures.
